title: Josiah says Auntie told an angel to tell him something

tellings.quote: e Auntie told an angel to tell me auntie was my great aunt and she died at age 89

plain: A boy named Josiah, one of the children in a documentary about kids said to communicate by telepathy, told his mother that 'Auntie told an angel to tell me' something, and his mother explains that Auntie was his great-aunt, who had died at 89. His mother tells this on the show as something she witnessed, and she has written about him in a book called Josiah's Fire. If true, it would suggest the boy was getting messages from the dead.
